summary: Frontend mobile-responsive testing (Phase 1). Verified mobile bottom nav, per-route rendering, mobile card layouts and admin flow. All primary acceptance criteria satisfied at 390x844. Minor horizontal overflow found only at 320px on /expenses and /discom.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor horizontal overflow (~12px) at 320px viewport (iPhone SE). sw=332, cw=320. OK at 375+.
Minor horizontal overflow (~4px) at 320px viewport. sw=324, cw=320. OK at 375+.

verified_features: Mobile bottom nav (data-testid=mobile-bottom-nav) visible on /, /expenses, /hrms, /billing, /discom @ 390px with all 5 items (bnav-home, bnav-expenses, bnav-hrms, bnav-billing, bnav-discom).
Bnav hidden on /admin/login and /admin (post-login) — no duplication.
Bnav hidden at 1920x900 desktop across all public routes.
Active-state highlighting: bnav-expenses gets text-foreground+active class when on /expenses.
Tap navigation: clicking bnav-expenses from / correctly navigates to /expenses.
No horizontal overflow at 375/390/414/768 on all 10 tested routes.
HRMS Employees mobile: 8 emp-card-<code> rendered (EMP-0001..EMP-0008); desktop table hidden.
HRMS Attendance daily mobile: 16 att-status-<code> selects rendered inside mobile cards; desktop table (hidden md:block) not rendered.
Billing Rate Master mobile: rate cards render (12 rate-row-<id> in mobile block); desktop table hidden.
Billing Invoice list mobile card block present (0 invoices in system so no pay-status buttons to assert — verified table hidden).
Admin login flow: harivanshraj9@gmail.com / Prathvi@Admin2026 → /admin dashboard loads with 19 resources, 740,217 consumers, 8 employees, bnav hidden.
index.css bottom padding rule (calc(76px + safe-area) < 1024px) prevents nav overlap.
action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Fix 320px horizontal overflow on /expenses (~12px) and /discom (~4px). Likely a non-responsive wide element inside those pages. Not blocking since 375+ (smallest common modern phone) is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav uses lg:hidden and NavLink correctly.

Bottom padding via index.css targets 'main > div:last-child, main .py-6' which is a brittle selector — a cleaner approach would be a utility class (e.g., pb-bottom-nav) applied by page shells. Works today but may miss layouts that don't use those class names.
Billing invoice list mobile cards could not be fully verified (no invoices in DB). Confirm with seeded invoices in a follow-up.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (2 minor overflow at 320px, all other criteria pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only unresolved item is minor overflow at 320px on /expenses and /discom. All mobile card layouts (emp-card, att-status inside mobile block, rate-row inside md:hidden) confirmed. Billing invoice mobile cards untested due to empty invoices — seed an invoice to fully cover.
